name: WARNING: Old Bay Classic Seafood Seasoning (Coarse Celery Seed & Crushed Red Pepper)
whyItWorks: Famous seafood seasoning containing coarse crushed celery seeds, crushed red pepper flakes, black pepper, and paprika. The hard insoluble celery seed particles create rough grit across inflamed mucosa.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Season seafood with pure fine sea salt, fresh lemon juice (if in remission), and melted ghee rather than Old Bay.
